meta.source: Curated by the team from news, ITD, BYU-Idaho, church and city pages (each project has its own source)

projects.name: Madison Commons
projects.size: About 50 acres, about 250 homes, plus restaurant and retail space
projects.tripBasis: 250 homes x 6.7 trips a day. Commercial space not counted: tenants not announced.
projects.where: West of US-20 at Exit 333 (Main St), toward 12th West
projects.plain: A new neighborhood of homes, restaurants and shops by the Main Street exit, built in phases.
projects.evidence: Developer Trellis plans about 250 medium-density homes with restaurant and office/retail space. In February 2026 work had not started: site work and new roads come first, and a restaurant by the exit was to start that summer. Building the whole project is expected to take seven to ten years.
flags: Footprint placed between US-20 and 12th West from the article; exact parcel not mapped
Start date is assumed; end date is our reading of "seven to ten years"
A hotel "may be coming" and a rec center is in early talks with the city; neither is included

projects.name: White Owl Business Park and Homestead Assisted Living
projects.size: 26 acres; 11 acres for the assisted living campus
projects.tripBasis: Assumed 100 beds x 2.6 trips a day. Bed count is not in the source.
projects.where: West of Walmart on North 2nd East, next to the new temple
projects.plain: An assisted living campus with condos, a pool and pickleball courts; offices or medical space may follow around it.
projects.evidence: A 26-acre business park anchored by an 11-acre assisted living campus with a pool, pickleball courts, a walking trail and individual condos. A photo caption describes it as currently underway.
flags: Footprint placed west of the temple from the article; exact parcel not mapped
No completion date in the source; 2028 is assumed

projects.name: Teton River Idaho Temple
projects.tripBasis: Assumed 500 trips a day once open. No standard rate fits; replace with a local count.
projects.where: 111 Teton River Temple St, north Rexburg
projects.plain: A second Latter-day Saint temple for Rexburg, on the north end of town.
projects.evidence: Ground was broken June 1 2024. The source lists it under construction (exterior cladding, parking lot paving, landscaping and interior work). Open house and dedication dates have not been announced.
flags: Opening date not announced; mid-2027 is our estimate

projects.name: WinCo Foods
projects.tripBasis: 84,000 sq ft x 94 trips per 1,000 sq ft, less 35% assumed pass-by traffic.
projects.where: North 2nd East at East Moody Rd
projects.plain: A fourth large grocery store, on the north end of 2nd East.
projects.evidence: WinCo submitted plans in January 2025 for an 84,000-square-foot single-story store on an 11-acre lot at North 2nd East and East Moody Road (Squires subdivision), across from Walmart.
flags: The source gives no dates: "It's not clear when construction will get underway or be completed." Start and end are assumed
Placed on the northeast side of North 2nd East near 1256 N; exact lot not mapped

projects.name: Sundance student housing addition
projects.tripBasis: 220 units x 2.5 trips a day (low rate assumed inside the walk district).
projects.where: South Center St, next to the Post Office
projects.plain: Two new student apartment buildings a short walk from campus.
projects.evidence: Two buildings with 120 units for women and 100 for men, next to the Post Office. The whole project was slated to finish in fall 2026.
flags: Completion in fall 2026 was the plan; not confirmed as finished
Beds per unit not stated, so it is not added to the student bed count

projects.name: McKay Library remodel
projects.tripBasis: No new trips: a remodel of an existing building.
projects.plain: The campus library is being remodeled one wing at a time.
projects.evidence: Contractors began in August 2024. The university lists 2026 for completion of the first of two phases.
flags: The second phase has no date on the university page

projects.name: University Support Services Building
projects.size: Warehouse, loading docks, grounds facilities and offices
projects.tripBasis: Assumed 150 trips a day (staff and deliveries).
projects.where: Near the substation on University Blvd
projects.plain: A new warehouse and operations building for the university.
projects.evidence: A new facility with a warehouse, loading and receiving docks and offices near the substation on University Boulevard. Construction was expected to start in early 2025.
flags: No completion date on the university page; end of 2026 is assumed
Location on University Blvd is approximate

projects.name: 2nd West and 2nd South signal upgrade
projects.size: New signal cabinet, wiring and sidewalk repair
projects.tripBasis: No new trips. Model assumes 10% less capacity during work and 8% more after.
projects.plain: The traffic signal at 2nd West and 2nd South is being rebuilt.
projects.evidence: The city sought bids, due July 8 2026, for a new cabinet and foundation, new wiring, boring and sidewalk repair at this intersection.
flags: Construction dates are assumed from the bid date

projects.name: Main Street resurfacing (ITD)
projects.size: Main St from 2nd East to Pioneer Rd, and from Exit 333 to 12th West
projects.tripBasis: No new trips. Mostly night work, so the model takes 10% off daytime capacity.
projects.where: Main St, 2nd East to Pioneer Rd and Exit 333 to 12th West (the interchange itself unchanged)
projects.plain: Main Street was repaved in summer 2026, mostly at night.
projects.evidence: Work began June 15 2026; night work (7 pm to 7 am) from June 22, with street parking removed between 2nd East and 4th West. ITD expected it done by early August.
flags: Finish date is ITD's estimate (early August); not confirmed finished

projects.name: 2nd East sewer line
projects.size: 2nd East between Yellowstone Hwy and 7th North
projects.tripBasis: No new trips. One lane each way during work: model halves capacity.
projects.plain: A sewer line went in under 2nd East in late summer 2026, with lane closures.
projects.evidence: A three-day full closure from August 16 2026, then one lane each way for about 30 days while the sewer line was installed.

projects.name: North Yellowstone sewer line
projects.size: $9 million line serving Rexburg, Sugar City and Teton
projects.where: Between Moody Rd and Riverside Park
projects.plain: An aging sewer main north of town was replaced with a larger one.
projects.evidence: Under construction since April 2025, the project replaced, realigned and enlarged a line built around 1980. The city reported it nearing completion in November 2026.
flags: Drawn along North Yellowstone Hwy; the real route is approximate

unmapped.name: The Home Depot
unmapped.note: Planning and Zoning recommended approval of a roughly 40-acre plat in July 2026, with Home Depot buying 10 acres. The source does not say where, so it is not on the map or in the traffic model. The source page blocks automated reading, so this could not be rechecked; the mayor's State of the City also named Home Depot as coming.

context.name: US-20 diverging diamond interchanges (Exits 332 and 333)
context.note: Rebuilt by ITD in 2024. Shown as existing.
